integrity: Analytic proof and a standalone symbolic/exact finite-state checker; computational spot checks do not establish infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: Neutral one-site mutants on finite unweighted loopless trees only.
The sharp minimum is among trees; no uniqueness among all six-vertex graphs is asserted.
The factor-two family statement is an attainable asymptotic lower bound on improvement, not a global optimum.
Independent priority and mathematical audits not performed.
title: A sharp six-vertex onset and an infinite amplification family for nonmonotone neutral fixation on trees
